acceptanceCriteria: A reproduction or reasoned demonstration shows which hazard is real.
Existing tests using the helpers still pass.
One shared helper replaces the copies with a bounded timeout and no detached maintenance.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, origin/main 8a3e3a5b. Suspected, partly verified by read: internal/liveverify/affected/golang/golang_test.go:137 defines runGit, which runs exec.Command(git, -C root, ...) with os.Environ() plus fixed identity/config vars, CombinedOutput, no context or timeout, no process-group cleanup, and no auto-maintenance disabling (gc.auto/maintenance.auto). Near-identical helpers exist at internal/liveverify/mutate/mutate_test.go:125 and internal/liveverify/pymutate/pymutate_test.go:134 (those return output). Hazard (inference): three divergent copies drift; a hung git blocks the package until the test timeout and background auto-maintenance can race t.TempDir cleanup, the failure class of V1-0351, V1-0427 and V1-0662. Expected: one shared hardened test helper (timeout, group cleanup, maintenance off). Actual: three copies. Needs verification before changing.
title: Duplicated runGit test helper (internal/liveverify/.../golang_test.go:137) inherits the environment with no timeout or maintenance guard
